newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah fluctuates on campaign violence.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah fluctuates on campaign violence.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fluctuated slightly against the dollar in the late afternoon because of a fresh outbreak of campaign-related violence, dealers said.

They said the rupiah softened slightly to 2,444.0 before recovering to 2,443.25 later. But one Japanese bank dealer said London operators came in later and pushed up the dollar again to 2,444.0/45.0 as they reacted to the news of the clashes.
"There was no panic in the local market. We were about to cool down and the rupiah was about to recover when London came in in an otherwise thin market," one Japanese bank dealer said.
Dealers said there was no panic because Singapore operators had squared positions ahead of the public holiday on Wednesday.
"They don't want to ruin their positions shortly before the holiday. There were some responses from London," one said.

Police backed by troops broke up a street battle in the Otista area of eastern Jakarta between supporters of the ruling Golkar and the minority Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) in which knives and machetes were brandished.
Police also fired tear gas to disperse crowds in the Warung Buncit area in the south of the city of 10 million people, witnesses said.
There were no immediate reports of injuries or arrests.
Dealers said the rupiah was relatively firm before the riot reports although liquidity was ample. Overnight rupiah fell to about five percent from 8.0/9.0 percent.
One foreign bank dealer said sentiment had turned biddish on the dollar after coming under some downward correction.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,441.25/41.75 and 2,443.75/44.00, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.25/0.35 and tom/next at 0.15/0.25.
Dealers said longer-term swaps fell across the board following an easing in short-term liquidity.
They said offshore operators could not afford to hold on to long forward positions while tom/next swaps were cheap.
One-month swap was at 15.0/16.0, two at 26.0/30.0, three at 42.0/43.0 and six at 82.0/83.0.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,410/2,602 but raised its conversion band by one point to 2,419/2,467 on Tuesday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
